summary.text: Chris Oldham is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 58 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Helen Kerwin.
A retired Verizon employee, he says he is running to expand Medicaid and oppose school vouchers.

paragraphs.text: Oldham graduated from Fredericksburg High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Angelo State University in 1991.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a native Texan who has lived in Mansfield since 2019, and that he spent 30 years at Verizon in roles ranging from purchasing to systems management before retiring in 2024.
Oldham said his campaign messages include expanding Medicaid to keep rural hospitals open, fully funding local schools and raising teacher pay, and opposing school voucher programs.
